note: Small national-forest campground on the Pine River, a state wild river, about 20 miles west of Florence. An artesian well by the entrance flows all year. A carry-in canoe access nearby is a common start or end for Pine River trips, a one-mile trail leads to Lost Lake Campground, and the Lauterman trail's south trailhead is across the river. Sites are back-in on asphalt; sites 2, 3, 4 and 6 take 25 ft and site 1 takes 35 ft. --Claude
summary: Read the campground's own FS page. The stored website and fees were Lauterman NRA's (five walk-in sites, $5); this campground is $15 ($7.50 with an interagency pass), 6 back-in sites (25-40 ft), vault toilet, artesian well, FCFS only, open April 30 - November 30. Not on recreation.gov. Not waterfront confirmed.
flags: WRONG CAMPGROUND DATA: the stored website (Lauterman National Recreation Area) and the fees provenance quote describe Lauterman Lake's five walk-in sites ('Single Site: $5 per night'). Chipmunk Rapids' own page says $15 -> fees 5 -> 15.
PHONE: 715-528-4464 -> 715-479-2827 (Eagle River-Florence Ranger District, as the FS page lists it).
SEASON: new, 04-30..11-30 (FS 'Seasons of Use'). The stored inclusion_evidence's 'open May-Oct' is out of date.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed. The Pine River here is about 20-30 m wide (creek-sized under the 30 m rule), and the campground loop (about 45.8925,-88.5569) sits 50-60 m south of it through unbroken forest on Esri imagery.
PIN: stored 45.8928,-88.5582 is on the entrance road about 100 m west of the loop; FS gives 45.8925,-88.55667. Under 250 m; optional move to 45.8925,-88.5569.
